description: This file defines utility functions for converting Protocol Buffer schemas to Spark SQL schemas, including handling of nested and recursive message types, well-known types, and options for schema conversion.
external_files: com.google.protobuf.{BoolValue, BytesValue, DoubleValue, FloatValue, Int32Value, Int64Value, StringValue, UInt32Value, UInt64Value}

classes.name: SchemaType
classes.description: Internal wrapper class for representing a Spark SQL DataType with nullability.

methods.name: toSqlType
methods.description: Converts a protobuf Descriptor to a Spark SQL SchemaType, considering protobuf options.

methods.name: toSqlTypeHelper
methods.description: Helper method that performs the core conversion of Descriptor to SchemaType, handling empty messages.

methods.name: structFieldFor
methods.description: Recursively converts a protobuf FieldDescriptor into a Spark StructField, handling nested messages, maps, repeated fields, and recursion limits.

methods.name: convertEmptyProtoToStructWithDummyField
methods.description: Creates a dummy StructType for empty protobuf messages to satisfy Spark's schema requirements.
